name: Terminal Knee Extension
instructions: Tie band behind knee facing anchor point. Straighten knee against resistance, keeping hip neutral.

name: Mini Squat
instructions: Feet shoulder-width. Squat to ~45° keeping knees over toes and weight through heels.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Rear foot elevated on bench behind you. Lower front knee toward floor then return.

name: Clamshell
instructions: Side-lying, knees bent. Keep feet stacked and rotate top knee toward ceiling.

name: Side-Lying Hip Abduction
instructions: Side-lying, top leg straight. Lift leg to ~30° keeping body in a straight line.

name: Single-Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand on one leg. Hinge at hips reaching opposite hand toward floor, return.

name: External Rotation with Band
instructions: Elbow at side, forearm parallel to floor. Rotate forearm outward against band resistance.

name: Resistance Band Row
instructions: Hinge slightly forward. Pull band to hip squeezing shoulder blade back and down.

name: Push-Up Plus
instructions: Standard push-up starting position. At top, add protraction by spreading shoulder blades apart.

name: Supine Heel Slide
instructions: Lying on back, brace core gently. Slide one heel along floor away and back.

name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lying on back, arms and knees at 90°. Lower opposite arm and leg without arching back.

name: Plank with Arm Reach
instructions: Hold plank position. Lift one arm forward while maintaining level hips.

name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Seated with feet flat. Raise both heels and slowly lower.

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand at step edge, heels hanging. Lower heels below step level then raise to toes.

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on one foot at step edge. Lower heel fully and raise to toes with control.

name: Pelvic Tilt
instructions: Lying on back, knees bent. Gently flatten lower back against floor and hold.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lying on back, feet flat. Drive hips up to form a straight line, squeeze glutes at top.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
instructions: Glute bridge position, one leg extended. Lift hips using only the planted leg.

name: VMO Quad Set
instructions: Seated or lying, leg straight. Tighten quad focusing on inner muscle, hold then relax.

name: Single-Leg Stance
instructions: Stand on one leg with slight knee bend. Maintain steady posture without trunk sway.

name: Single-Leg Squat to Chair
instructions: Stand on one leg in front of chair. Slowly lower until barely touching chair, return.

name: Hip Hinge Practice
instructions: Stand, feet hip-width. Hinge at hips keeping neutral spine, feel stretch in hamstrings.

name: Single-Leg RDL (Wall Support)
instructions: Fingertips on wall for balance. Balance on one leg and hinge forward slowly, return.

name: Single-Leg Hop and Hold
instructions: Hop forward on one leg and stick the landing. Hold without wobbling for 2–3 seconds.

name: Isometric Wall Press
instructions: Place palm flat against wall at shoulder height. Press gently and hold.

name: Bear Crawl Hold
instructions: On hands and knees, lift knees 2 inches off floor. Brace core and hold.

name: Prone Y-T-W
instructions: Lying face down, raise arms to form Y, T, then W shapes. Focus on shoulder blade control.

name: Abdominal Brace
instructions: Lying on back. Gently brace core as if about to be poked, breathe normally.

name: Pallof Press
instructions: Stand sideways to band anchor. Press band away from chest resisting trunk rotation.

name: Copenhagen Plank
instructions: Side plank with top foot on bench. Hold body straight without hip drop.

name: Seated Ankle Alphabet
instructions: Seated, foot off floor. Trace the alphabet with your big toe, keeping leg still.

name: Single-Leg Balance
instructions: Balance on one leg with slight knee bend. Maintain without wobbling or hip drop.

name: Single-Leg Balance on Foam
instructions: Balance on one leg on foam or folded mat. Maintain full alignment for set duration.

name: Knee to Chest
instructions: Lying on back. Pull one knee to chest and hold. Keep opposite leg relaxed.

name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor
instructions: One knee on pad, opposite foot forward. Shift weight forward until stretch felt in front hip.

name: Standing Rectus Femoris Stretch
instructions: Standing, hold ankle behind you. Pull heel toward glutes keeping knees together.

name: Supine Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Lying on back. Hold behind thigh and gently straighten knee until stretch felt.

name: Standing Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Heel on step, stand tall. Hinge forward from hips until stretch felt in back of thigh.

name: Neural Floss
instructions: Seated upright, extend knee and dorsiflex ankle simultaneously. Add neck flexion for tension.

name: Standing Gastroc Stretch
instructions: Stand at wall, one foot back, heel flat. Lean forward until stretch felt in calf.

name: Soleus Stretch
instructions: Same as gastroc but bend the back knee slightly to target the soleus.

name: Eccentric Heel Drop
instructions: Stand on step edge, rise on both feet, then lower slowly on one foot through full range.

name: Cross-Body Stretch
instructions: Pull one arm across chest with opposite hand. Feel stretch in back of shoulder.

name: Doorway Pec Stretch
instructions: Stand in doorway, arm at 90°. Gently step forward until stretch felt across chest.

name: Sleeper Stretch
instructions: Side-lying on affected shoulder, elbow at 90°. Gently press forearm toward floor.

name: Foam Roller Extension
instructions: Place foam roller perpendicular under mid-back. Allow gentle extension over the roller.

name: Thread the Needle
instructions: On all fours, slide one arm under body. Follow with gaze and allow rotation.

name: Book Openings
instructions: Side-lying, knees bent. Rotate top arm to opposite side following with eyes, return.

name: Supine Figure-4
instructions: Lying on back, cross ankle over opposite knee. Gently pull thigh toward chest.

name: Seated Piriformis Stretch
instructions: Seated, cross foot over opposite knee. Sit tall and lean gently forward from hips.

name: Pigeon Pose
instructions: From kneeling, slide front shin forward and lower hips toward floor.

name: Foam Roll Segmental Mob
instructions: Foam roller under mid-back. Shift slowly to each thoracic level, pausing 2–3 seconds.

name: Seated Thoracic Rotation
instructions: Seated with arms crossed. Rotate trunk side to side through comfortable range.

name: Thoracic CARS
instructions: Seated upright. Perform slow controlled articular rotation of thoracic spine through full range.

name: Supine Hip Circles
instructions: Lying on back. Draw slow, large circles with your knee exploring full hip range.

name: 90/90 Hip Mobility
instructions: Sit in 90/90 position, both knees at 90°. Shift weight toward back hip, sit tall.

name: Hip CARS
instructions: Stand on one leg. Draw large controlled circles with opposite hip through full range.

name: Pendulum
instructions: Lean forward supporting torso. Let arm hang and draw small circles, gradually enlarging.

name: Shoulder Pulley
instructions: Use overhead pulley. Assist affected arm toward full elevation with uninvolved arm.

name: Shoulder CARS
instructions: Stand upright. Perform slow full shoulder circumduction keeping scapula controlled.

name: Ankle Alphabet
instructions: Seated, foot off floor. Trace the alphabet with your big toe in both directions.

name: Knee to Wall
instructions: Lunge stance, front foot close to wall. Drive knee forward over 4th toe, return.

name: Banded Ankle Distraction
instructions: Band around ankle from behind. Drive knee forward into dorsiflexion through full range.

name: Chin Tuck
instructions: Sitting tall. Draw chin straight back (retraction) without tilting head, hold briefly.

name: Cervical AROM
instructions: Seated upright. Move slowly through flexion, extension, rotation, and side bending.

name: Cervical CARS
instructions: Seated upright. Perform slow controlled articular rotation of cervical spine through full range.

name: Isometric Shoulder Flexion
instructions: Stand facing wall, arm at side. Place back of hand against wall. Press gently forward without moving arm. Hold, then relax.

name: Shoulder Forward Raise with Band
instructions: Stand on band, hold at thigh. Keeping elbow straight, raise arm forward to shoulder height. Lower slowly.

name: Overhead Press
instructions: Stand with band under feet, handles at shoulder height. Press straight overhead through full shoulder flexion range. Control the descent.

name: Prone Shoulder Extension
instructions: Lying face down, arm at side. Keeping elbow straight, lift arm toward ceiling. Focus on posterior deltoid contraction. Lower slowly.

name: Shoulder Extension with Band
instructions: Face band anchor at shoulder height. Pull arm straight back past hip, keeping elbow extended. Squeeze posterior shoulder at end range.

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
instructions: Attach band overhead. Keeping elbow straight, pull arm down to hip in a wide arc. Resist on the return and control throughout.

name: Shoulder Shrug
instructions: Stand with arms at sides. Elevate both shoulders straight up toward ears, hold briefly, then slowly lower. Focus on upper trapezius.

name: Banded Shoulder Elevation
instructions: Stand on band, handles at sides. Shrug shoulders up toward ears against band resistance. Pause at top and slowly lower.

name: Upright Row with Band
instructions: Stand on band, hands close together. Pull band straight up along body to chin level, leading with elbows. Lower slowly.

name: Seated Scapular Depression
instructions: Sit upright with hands beside hips. Press palms lightly into chair and slide shoulder blades down away from ears. Hold briefly and release.

name: Scapular Depression with Band
instructions: Attach band overhead, hold with both hands. Pull shoulder blades down against band resistance, keeping arms straight. Focus on lower trapezius.

name: Bar Hang Scapular Depression
instructions: Hang from bar with arms straight. Without bending elbows, actively depress shoulder blades to slightly elevate body. Hold, then relax back to passive hang.

name: Supine Chin Tuck and Nod
instructions: Lying on back, perform a chin tuck. Then gently nod head by lifting only the base of skull off surface (not a full sit-up). Return slowly.

name: Supine Cervical Head Lift
instructions: Lying on back, perform chin tuck. Lift head 1–2 inches off surface keeping chin tucked. Hold briefly and lower with control.

name: Resisted Cervical Flexion
instructions: Seated upright. Place hand on forehead. Press forehead into hand (cervical flexion) and resist with hand. Equal force so no movement occurs. Hold.

name: Prone Cervical Extension
instructions: Lying face down with forehead on a small folded towel. Gently lift head a small amount, keeping chin tucked. Hold briefly and lower.

name: Prone Head Lift
instructions: Lying face down, forehead on towel. Lift head through full cervical extension range, keeping eyes on floor. Hold at top and slowly lower.

name: Resisted Cervical Extension
instructions: Seated upright. Clasp both hands behind head. Press head backward into hands while hands resist. No movement — pure isometric contraction. Hold.

name: Isometric Cervical Rotation
instructions: Seated upright. Place hand on side of jaw. Attempt to rotate head into hand while hand resists all movement. Hold, then switch sides.

name: Cervical Rotation with Band
instructions: Attach light band to a stable point at head height. Secure other end to forehead with pad. Slowly rotate head away from anchor against resistance. Return with control.

name: Cervical Rotation with Retraction
instructions: Seated upright, chin tucked slightly. Rotate head fully to one side maintaining retraction throughout. Return through center and repeat other side. Control each repetition.

name: Seated Bicep Curl
instructions: Seated, hold light band or weight with palm up. Keeping elbow at side, curl forearm toward shoulder. Lower slowly through full range.

name: Standing Bicep Curl
instructions: Stand on band, palm up. Curl forearm to shoulder keeping upper arm fixed at side. Slowly lower and fully extend before next rep.

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand on band, thumb pointing up (neutral grip). Curl forearm to shoulder without rotating wrist. Targets brachialis and brachioradialis. Lower fully between reps.

name: Tricep Kickback
instructions: Hinge forward at hips with support. Hold band or weight, elbow at 90° at side. Straighten elbow behind you and slowly return.

name: Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Hold band overhead behind head, elbows pointing up. Extend elbows to straighten arms overhead. Keep upper arms fixed and lower with control.

name: Tricep Pushdown
instructions: Attach band overhead. Hold handles, elbows at sides at 90°. Push handles straight down until elbows are fully extended. Return slowly — do not let elbows drift forward.

name: Cervical Flexion Stretch
instructions: Seated or standing, gently drop chin toward chest. Place hand on back of head for light overpressure if tolerated. Feel stretch along back of neck.

name: Suboccipital Release
instructions: Seated, interlace fingers behind head. Tuck chin and gently apply downward pressure to base of skull. Focus on the junction between skull and first vertebra.

name: Cervical Extension Stretch
instructions: Seated tall, gently tilt head back looking toward ceiling. Move only through a comfortable range. Feel stretch along front of neck. Return slowly.

name: Cervical Rotation Stretch
instructions: Seated upright. Slowly rotate head to look over one shoulder through comfortable range. Hold at end range. Return through center and repeat other side.

name: Sternocleidomastoid Stretch
instructions: Seated, stabilize shoulder with opposite hand. Rotate head away and gently extend, feeling stretch along front-side of neck. Do not force range.

name: Upper Trapezius Stretch
instructions: Seated, stabilize one shoulder by holding edge of chair. Gently tilt ear toward opposite shoulder. Feel stretch along top of shoulder and side of neck.

name: Levator Scapulae Stretch
instructions: Seated, hold chair with one hand. Rotate head 45° away, then tilt ear toward armpit. Feel deep stretch at base of skull behind shoulder. Light hand overpressure optional.

name: Shoulder Depression Stretch
instructions: Seated, actively depress one shoulder downward while tilting head to opposite side. Hold the stretch along the top of shoulder. Release and repeat.

name: Bicep Stretch
instructions: Stand facing wall, place palm flat against wall at shoulder height with thumb up. Gently rotate body away until stretch felt along front of arm. Hold.

name: Doorway Bicep Stretch
instructions: Place palm on doorframe behind you at hip height, thumb pointing up. Keeping arm straight, rotate body forward until stretch felt through bicep and forearm. Hold.

name: Tricep Stretch
instructions: Raise arm overhead, bend elbow so hand reaches behind neck. Use other hand to gently push elbow further behind head. Feel stretch along back of upper arm.

name: Cross-Body Tricep Stretch
instructions: Reach arm across body at shoulder height, keeping elbow slightly bent. Use other hand to pull elbow across and gently flex it further. Feel stretch in tricep.

name: Anterior Shoulder Stretch
instructions: Stand in doorway or beside wall. Place arm behind body with palm flat against surface. Gently rotate torso forward until stretch felt along front of shoulder and chest.

name: Shoulder Flexion Overhead Stretch
instructions: Seated or standing, reach both arms fully overhead. Clasp hands and reach as high as possible, lengthening through the shoulder joint. Hold at end range.

name: Isometric Shoulder Abduction
instructions: Stand with arm at side, press back of hand into hip or wall. Push outward without moving arm. Equal force — pure isometric contraction for deltoid activation.

name: Lateral Raise with Band
instructions: Stand on band, arm at side. Raise arm out to the side to shoulder height, keeping slight elbow bend. Thumb slightly down (empty can). Lower with control.

name: Full-Can Exercise
instructions: Stand on band, arm at 30° forward of body plane (scapular plane). Raise arm to shoulder height with thumb pointing up (full can position). Lower slowly.

name: Internal Rotation with Band
instructions: Elbow at side at 90°, band attached laterally. Rotate forearm inward toward belly keeping upper arm fixed. Return slowly to start.

name: Side-Lying Internal Rotation
instructions: Side-lying on involved side, elbow at 90°. Rotate forearm upward against gravity. Focus on subscapularis activation. Lower slowly.

name: PNF D2 Flexion Pattern
instructions: Start with arm across body in extension and internal rotation. Sweep arm upward and outward ending overhead in external rotation. Reverse for return. Use band for resistance.

name: Knee-to-Wall Ankle Mobilization
instructions: Stand facing wall, foot 5 cm from base. Drive knee to touch wall keeping heel down. Progress distance.

name: Standing Ankle Dorsiflexion AROM
instructions: Standing at wall, hands on wall. Rock forward driving knee toward wall. Keep heel down.

name: Seated Ankle Dorsiflexion AROM
instructions: Seated, foot off floor. Pull foot upward toward shin through full dorsiflexion range. Return.

name: Ankle Eversion CARs
instructions: Seated or standing. Move foot through eversion combined with dorsiflexion in controlled arc.

name: Standing Ankle Eversion
instructions: Stand with support. Lift inner edge of foot turning sole outward. Hold briefly and return.

name: Seated Ankle Eversion AROM
instructions: Seated, foot off floor. Rotate sole outward through full eversion range. Control return.

name: Ankle Inversion CARs
instructions: Seated or standing. Move foot through inversion combined with plantarflexion in controlled arc.

name: Standing Ankle Inversion
instructions: Stand with support. Lift outer edge of foot turning sole inward. Hold briefly and return.

name: Seated Ankle Inversion AROM
instructions: Seated, foot off floor. Rotate sole inward through full inversion range. Control return.

name: Ankle Plantarflexion CARs
instructions: Seated or standing. Move foot through maximum plantarflexion arc including slight inversion and eversion.

name: Standing Calf Raise AROM
instructions: Stand at edge of step. Rise onto toes through maximum plantarflexion. Lower slowly.

name: Seated Ankle Plantarflexion AROM
instructions: Seated, foot off floor. Point foot downward through full plantarflexion range. Return.

name: Progressive Cervical Extension AROM
instructions: Seated, extend to end range, hold, then use hand support behind head to progress further.

name: Prone Cervical Extension
instructions: Lie face down. Slowly lift head and extend neck toward ceiling. Control return to floor.

name: Cervical Extension AROM
instructions: Seated tall. Slowly tilt chin upward toward ceiling through full comfortable range. Return to neutral.

name: Progressive Cervical Flexion AROM
instructions: Seated, flex cervical spine to end range, hold briefly, then attempt gentle overpressure with own hand.

name: Cervical Flexion with Chin Nod
instructions: Seated, first tuck chin then flex entire cervical spine forward. Dissociates upper from lower cervical.

name: Cervical Flexion AROM
instructions: Seated tall. Slowly drop chin toward chest through full comfortable range. Return to neutral.

name: Progressive Cervical Lateral Flexion
instructions: Lateral flexion to end range. Gently assist with hand to move through any remaining restriction.

name: Side-Lying Cervical Lateral Flexion
instructions: Lie on side without pillow. Slowly lift head toward ceiling (lateral flexion away from surface).

name: Cervical Lateral Flexion AROM
instructions: Seated tall. Tilt ear toward shoulder to each side through full comfortable range. Stay relaxed.

name: Cervical Rotation with Retraction
instructions: Seated, draw chin back into retraction. Rotate from this position left and right through full range.

name: Cervical Rotation AROM
instructions: Seated tall. Rotate chin toward each shoulder through full comfortable range. Keep level.

name: Elbow Extension CARs
instructions: Extend elbow to maximum range. At end range rotate forearm and attempt to gain further extension.

name: Elbow Extension with Load
instructions: Overhead arm with light weight. Slowly extend elbow to full straight. Lower. Emphasize end range.

name: Active Elbow Extension AROM
instructions: Seated, elbow bent. Slowly straighten elbow to full extension. Return. Emphasize end range.

name: Elbow Flexion CARs
instructions: Flex elbow to maximum range. At end range rotate forearm and attempt to gain further flexion.

name: Elbow Flexion with Load
instructions: Hold light weight. Slowly curl through full elbow flexion range. Lower fully. Emphasize end range.

name: Active Elbow Flexion AROM
instructions: Seated, elbow at side. Slowly bend elbow to full flexion. Lower to full extension. Full range.

name: Finger Abduction CARs
instructions: Abduct each finger individually in sequence from index to small finger. Control fully.

name: Progressive Finger Spreading
instructions: Spread fingers wide. Then spread each individually as far as possible. Hold each.

name: Finger Abduction AROM
instructions: Hand flat. Spread each finger apart from midline as wide as possible. Hold then adduct.

name: Finger Adduction CARs
instructions: Adduct each finger individually toward midline in sequence from small finger to index.

name: Progressive Finger Squeeze
instructions: Spread fingers wide. Adduct each adjacent pair together in sequence. Control movement.

name: Finger Adduction AROM
instructions: Fingers spread wide. Bring all fingers together squeezing into adduction. Hold then spread.

name: Composite Finger Extension CARs
instructions: From fist, extend digits sequentially through MCP, PIP, DIP. Arc through all joints smoothly.

name: Isolated MCP Extension
instructions: Curl PIP and DIP joints. Extend only at MCP joints lifting knuckles. Full range.

name: Finger Extension AROM
instructions: From full fist, slowly open hand spreading fingers into maximum extension. Repeat.

name: Composite Finger Flexion CARs
instructions: Move fingers through composite flexion: MCP, PIP, DIP sequentially. Arc through all joints.

name: Isolated MCP Flexion
instructions: Keep PIP and DIP straight. Bend only at MCP joints (knuckles). Full range then extend.

name: Finger Flexion AROM Full Fist
instructions: Open hand fully spreading fingers. Slowly close into full fist through maximum range. Repeat.

name: Progressive Toe Abduction
instructions: Standing barefoot. Abduct each toe individually away from midline. Work small toe to great toe.

name: Standing Toe Spreading
instructions: Standing barefoot. Spread toes wide against floor. Hold maximum abduction then release.

name: Seated Toe Spreading AROM
instructions: Seated barefoot. Spread all toes as wide as possible. Hold then relax together.

name: Progressive Toe Adduction
instructions: Standing barefoot. Adduct each toe toward midline individually in sequence.

name: Standing Toe Adduction
instructions: Standing barefoot. Squeeze toes together against floor resistance. Hold maximum adduction.

name: Seated Toe Adduction AROM
instructions: Seated barefoot. Squeeze all toes together actively. Hold then spread apart.

name: Dynamic Toe Extension
instructions: Standing barefoot. Lift toes in sequence from great toe outward. Control each individually.

name: Standing Toe Extension AROM
instructions: Standing barefoot. Lift all toes off floor into extension keeping ball of foot down. Hold.

name: Seated Toe Extension AROM
instructions: Seated barefoot. Lift all toes upward into extension. Hold briefly then lower fully.

name: Dynamic Toe Flexion
instructions: Standing barefoot. Alternate curling and releasing toes in sequence from great toe to small toe.

name: Standing Toe Curl AROM
instructions: Standing barefoot. Actively curl toes into flexion. Hold and release through full range.

name: Seated Toe Curl AROM
instructions: Seated barefoot. Curl all toes downward into flexion. Hold briefly then straighten fully.

name: Hip Abduction CARs
instructions: Standing, move hip through abduction, external rotation arc in controlled large motion.

name: Standing Hip Abduction AROM
instructions: Standing on one leg. Lift opposite leg out to side through full range. Use wall for balance.

name: Side-Lying Hip Abduction AROM
instructions: Lie on side, leg straight. Lift top leg as high as possible through abduction range. Lower slowly.

name: Hip Adduction CARs
instructions: Standing, arc hip through adduction and internal rotation in controlled large motion.

name: Standing Hip Adduction AROM
instructions: Standing on one leg. Sweep opposite leg across front of body into adduction. Use wall for balance.

name: Supine Hip Adduction AROM
instructions: Lie on back, leg raised. Cross leg over midline into adduction. Return to neutral. Repeat.

name: 90-90 External Rotation
instructions: Seated 90-90 position. Rotate torso toward back shin driving hip into external rotation.

name: Prone Hip External Rotation
instructions: Lie face down, knee bent to 90 degrees. Let foot fall inward rotating hip outward. Control.

name: Seated Hip External Rotation AROM
instructions: Seated, knee bent. Rotate foot inward moving hip into external rotation. Return and repeat.

name: Hip Extension CARs
instructions: Standing, drive hip into extension and arc through full posterior range. Control throughout.

name: Standing Hip Extension AROM
instructions: Standing on one leg. Swing opposite leg back into extension. Keep trunk upright.

name: Prone Hip Extension AROM
instructions: Lie face down. Keeping knee bent, lift thigh off floor extending hip. Keep pelvis flat.

name: Hip Flexion CARs
instructions: Standing on one leg. Drive opposite knee high, rotate hip, and lower through controlled arc.

name: Standing Hip March
instructions: Standing tall. Alternate lifting knees high toward chest. Control each movement. Stay upright.

name: Supine Hip Flexion AROM
instructions: Lie on back. Slowly draw one knee toward chest through hip flexion range. Lower and repeat.

name: 90-90 Internal Rotation
instructions: Seated 90-90 position. Rotate torso toward front shin driving hip into internal rotation.

name: Prone Hip Internal Rotation
instructions: Lie face down, knee bent to 90 degrees. Let foot fall out to side rotating hip inward. Control.

name: Seated Hip Internal Rotation AROM
instructions: Seated, knee bent. Rotate foot outward moving hip into internal rotation. Return and repeat.

name: Single-Leg Tibial ER AROM
instructions: Single-leg balance, knee slightly bent. Rotate tibia outward through full range. Control.

name: Standing Tibial External Rotation
instructions: Standing, slightly flex knee. Rotate lower leg outward. Use wall for balance.

name: Seated Tibial External Rotation AROM
instructions: Seated, knee at 90 degrees. Rotate foot and lower leg outward (tibial ER). Control return.

name: Terminal Knee Extension with Band
instructions: Band behind knee. Stand on one leg. Complete last degrees of knee extension against band.

name: Standing Knee Extension AROM
instructions: Lean on wall. Slowly straighten knee pressing heel into floor from 90 degrees to full extension.

name: Long Arc Quad AROM
instructions: Seated at edge of chair. Slowly straighten knee to full extension. Hold briefly and lower.

name: Prone Knee Flexion AROM
instructions: Lie face down. Bend knee bringing heel toward glute through maximum range. Control throughout.

name: Seated Knee Flexion AROM
instructions: Seated at edge of chair. Slowly swing lower leg forward and back through maximum range.

name: Supine Heel Slide
instructions: Lie on back, leg flat. Slowly slide heel toward glute bending knee. Slide back to straight.

name: Single-Leg Tibial IR AROM
instructions: Single-leg balance, knee slightly bent. Rotate tibia inward through full range. Control.

name: Standing Tibial Internal Rotation
instructions: Standing, slightly flex knee. Rotate lower leg inward (pigeon-toe). Use wall for balance.

name: Seated Tibial Internal Rotation AROM
instructions: Seated, knee at 90 degrees. Rotate foot and lower leg inward (tibial IR). Control return.

name: Standing Lumbar Extension AROM
instructions: Standing, hands on hips. Lean back through maximum lumbar extension range. Return slowly.

name: Cow Pose Extension
instructions: Hands and knees. Drop belly toward floor (cow) arching lumbar spine into extension. Hold.

name: Prone Press-Up
instructions: Lie face down, elbows under shoulders. Press up onto elbows arching low back. Keep hips on floor.

name: Standing Lumbar Flexion AROM
instructions: Standing, hinge forward at hips. Move through maximum lumbar flexion range. Return slowly.

name: Cat Pose Flexion
instructions: Hands and knees. Round lower spine upward (cat) pressing lumbar spine toward ceiling. Hold.

name: Supine Knees to Chest
instructions: Lie on back. Draw both knees toward chest moving lumbar spine into full flexion. Hold briefly.

name: Standing Lumbar Lateral Flexion
instructions: Standing, fix feet. Slide one hand down thigh into lateral flexion. Keep hips level.

name: Side-Lying Lumbar Lateral Flexion
instructions: Lie on side, hips stacked. Lift torso sideways away from floor. Control return.

name: Seated Lateral Lumbar Bend
instructions: Seated, hand on opposite knee. Lean trunk to side moving through lumbar lateral flexion range.

name: Standing Trunk Rotation
instructions: Standing, arms crossed. Rotate trunk from side to side through full range at comfortable pace.

name: Seated Trunk Rotation AROM
instructions: Seated tall. Rotate trunk to each side keeping pelvis still. Move through maximum range.

name: Supine Lumbar Rotation
instructions: Lie on back, knees bent. Drop knees to each side slowly moving through lumbar rotation.

name: Scapular Depression CARs
instructions: Depress scapulae fully then transition into protraction and retraction in combined arc.

name: Scapular Depression with Load
instructions: Seated, hands on chair seat beside hips. Push through hands to depress and elevate body slightly.

name: Scapular Depression AROM
instructions: Seated or standing. Push both shoulders downward away from ears through full range. Return slowly.

name: Dynamic Scapular Downward Rotation
instructions: From full overhead, lower arm along scapular plane through complete downward rotation arc.

name: Scapular Depression and Retraction Combined
instructions: From overhead position, pull arm down and back combining depression and retraction.

name: Scapular Downward Rotation AROM
instructions: From arm overhead, slowly lower arm to side. Focus on scapular downward rotation movement.

name: Scapular Elevation CARs
instructions: Elevate scapulae fully then transition to other positions in full scapular CARs sequence.

name: Scapular Elevation with Load
instructions: Hold light weight in hands. Shrug shoulders toward ears through full range. Slow controlled return.

name: Scapular Elevation AROM
instructions: Seated or standing. Shrug both shoulders toward ears slowly through full range. Lower slowly.

name: Serratus Punch AROM
instructions: Lie on back, arm pointing toward ceiling. Punch arm further toward ceiling protracting scapula fully.

name: Wall Push-Up Protraction
instructions: Hands on wall at chest height. At end of push-up, push further protracting scapulae. Return.

name: Scapular Protraction AROM
instructions: Seated, arms at sides. Round shoulder forward protracting scapula fully. Return to retraction.

name: Prone Retraction AROM
instructions: Lie face down, arms at sides. Squeeze shoulder blades together lifting arms slightly. Control.

name: Band-Resisted Retraction AROM
instructions: Light band in hands. Pull shoulder blades back and together against resistance. Control forward.

name: Scapular Retraction AROM
instructions: Seated or standing. Squeeze shoulder blades together protracting through full range. Return.

name: Progressive Shoulder Elevation AROM
instructions: Raise arm overhead. At end range, add slight traction reaching further. Move through full upward rotation.

name: Arm Elevation Upward Rotation
instructions: Standing. Raise arm in scapular plane to full overhead. Pause at 60, 90, and 120 degrees.

name: Scapular Upward Rotation AROM
instructions: Standing. Slowly raise one arm forward to full overhead position. Focus on scapular rotation.

name: Shoulder Abduction CARs
instructions: Abduct arm to maximum. Rotate arm in this position and move through rotational arc.

name: Assisted Shoulder Abduction AROM
instructions: Use other hand or pulley to assist arm into abduction. Aim for full 180 degrees.

name: Shoulder Abduction AROM
instructions: Standing. Raise arm out to side to comfortable end range. Lower slowly.

name: Shoulder Adduction CARs
instructions: Sweep arm through full adduction arc from abduction to across midline in controlled motion.

name: Cross-Body Horizontal Adduction AROM
instructions: Bring arm across chest. Apply gentle overpressure with opposite hand at end range. Return.

name: Shoulder Adduction AROM
instructions: Standing. Cross arm across body into horizontal adduction. Return to neutral.

name: Sidelying Shoulder ER AROM
instructions: Lie on side, elbow at 90. Let forearm drop toward floor into ER. Assist with other hand.

name: Shoulder ER AROM
instructions: Elbow at 90 degrees at side. Rotate forearm outward away from stomach. Return to neutral.

name: Shoulder Extension CARs
instructions: Move arm through maximum extension arc. At end range, attempt to reach further back.

name: Progressive Shoulder Extension AROM
instructions: Prone lying. Lift arm from side into extension. Increase range each repetition.

name: Shoulder Extension AROM
instructions: Standing. Swing arm back behind body into extension. Keep elbow straight. Return.

name: Shoulder Flexion CARs
instructions: Raise arm to maximum flexion. At end range, attempt to reach further into new range.

name: Shoulder Pulley Assisted Flexion
instructions: Pulley anchored above door. Use uninvolved arm to pull involved arm into flexion range.

name: Shoulder Flexion AROM
instructions: Standing or seated. Raise arm forward to comfortable end range. Lower slowly.

name: Shoulder IR CARs
instructions: Elbow at 90 degrees. Move forearm through maximum IR arc. At end range, increase range gently.

name: Sidelying Shoulder IR AROM
instructions: Lie on back, elbow at 90 at side. Let forearm drop toward floor into IR. Assist if needed.

name: Shoulder IR AROM
instructions: Elbow at 90 degrees at side. Rotate forearm inward toward stomach. Return to neutral.

name: Thoracic Extension CARs
instructions: Seated, hands behind head. Isolate and extend thoracic spine only as far as possible without lumbar.

name: Foam Roller Thoracic Extension
instructions: Foam roller perpendicular under mid-back. Support head. Extend over roller at each spinal level.

name: Seated Thoracic Extension
instructions: Seated, hands behind head. Open elbows and gently extend thoracic spine backward.

name: Foam Roller Thoracic Flexion
instructions: Foam roller lengthwise under spine. Flex thoracic spine to each side off roller for segmental motion.

name: Cat Pose
instructions: Hands and knees. Round spine fully toward ceiling (cat) pressing mid-back up. Hold then release.

name: Seated Thoracic Flexion
instructions: Seated, clasp hands together. Round upper back forward letting shoulder blades spread apart.

name: Standing Thoracic Side Bend
instructions: Standing, fix pelvis. Reach one arm up and over bending only through thoracic spine not lumbar.

name: Side-Lying Thoracic Lateral Flexion
instructions: Lie on side over foam roller at waist. Allow upper body to drop laterally opening thoracic side.

name: Seated Thoracic Side Bend
instructions: Seated, raise one arm overhead. Lean to opposite side bending through thoracic spine.

name: Wrist Extension CARs
instructions: Extend wrist to maximum. At end range, add finger extension and attempt to gain more range.

name: Wrist Extension with Load
instructions: Forearm on table, hand off edge palm down. Lift wrist through full extension with light weight.

name: Wrist Extension AROM
instructions: Elbow supported. Slowly extend wrist through full range. Return to neutral. Repeat.

name: Wrist Flexion CARs
instructions: Flex wrist to maximum. At end range, add finger flexion and attempt to gain more range.

name: Wrist Flexion with Load
instructions: Forearm on table, hand off edge. Slowly flex wrist through full range with light weight.

name: Wrist Flexion AROM
instructions: Elbow supported. Slowly flex wrist through full range. Return to neutral. Repeat.

name: Pronation CARs
instructions: Move through maximum pronation and combine with wrist ulnar deviation in arc. Full range.

name: Forearm Pronation with Load
instructions: Hold hammer at mid-shaft. Rotate forearm palm down through full pronation. Return slowly.

name: Forearm Pronation AROM
instructions: Elbow at 90 degrees. Slowly rotate forearm palm down through full pronation range. Return.

name: Radial Deviation CARs
instructions: Move through maximum radial deviation. Arc into extension and return through neutral continuously.

name: Radial Deviation with Load
instructions: Hold hammer vertically. Move wrist toward thumb side against hammer head weight. Full range.

name: Wrist Radial Deviation AROM
instructions: Forearm supported, thumb up. Move wrist toward thumb side through full range. Return.

name: Supination CARs
instructions: Move through maximum supination and combine with wrist radial deviation in arc. Full range.

name: Forearm Supination with Load
instructions: Hold hammer at mid-shaft. Rotate forearm palm up through full supination. Return slowly.

name: Forearm Supination AROM
instructions: Elbow at 90 degrees. Slowly rotate forearm palm up through full supination range. Return.

name: Ulnar Deviation CARs
instructions: Move through maximum ulnar deviation. Arc into flexion and return through neutral continuously.

name: Ulnar Deviation with Load
instructions: Hold hammer vertically. Move wrist toward small finger side against hammer weight. Full range.

name: Wrist Ulnar Deviation AROM
instructions: Forearm supported, thumb up. Move wrist toward small finger side through full range. Return.

name: Single-Leg Heel Walk
instructions: Balance on one heel with forefoot raised. Step forward on single heel. Maintain balance and control.

name: Heel Walk
instructions: Stand and lift both forefeet off floor. Walk forward on heels only keeping toes raised.

name: Seated Ankle Dorsiflexion with Band
instructions: Seated, band around foot anchored in front. Pull foot up and back against resistance. Control return.

name: Single-Leg Balance Eversion Challenge
instructions: Single-leg balance on uneven surface. Focus on peroneal activation to maintain eversion control.

name: Standing Ankle Eversion
instructions: Stand sideways near wall. Lift inner edge of foot turning sole outward. Hold and return.

name: Seated Ankle Eversion with Band
instructions: Seated, band around outside of foot anchored inward. Push foot outward against resistance. Control return.

name: Short Foot Arch Hold
instructions: Standing, pull ball of foot toward heel without curling toes doming the arch. Hold against resistance.

name: Standing Tibialis Posterior Activation
instructions: Stand on one foot. Slightly supinate foot pressing inner arch upward. Hold and release. Repeat.

name: Seated Ankle Inversion with Band
instructions: Seated, band around inside of foot anchored outward. Pull foot inward against resistance. Control return.

name: Resisted Cervical Extension with Band
instructions: Loop band around forehead anchored to wall. Extend neck back against band resistance. Control return.

name: Seated Isometric Cervical Extension
instructions: Seated, clasp hands behind head. Press head back into hands resisting all movement. Hold isometric contraction.

name: Resisted Cervical Flexion with Band
instructions: Loop band around back of head anchored to wall. Flex neck forward against band resistance. Control return.

name: Seated Isometric Cervical Flexion
instructions: Seated, press forehead firmly into palm. Resist all movement and hold the isometric contraction.

name: Supine Chin Tuck
instructions: Lie on back. Gently tuck chin straight back and hold. Keep neck relaxed.

name: Side-Lying Cervical Rotation
instructions: Lie on side. Rotate chin toward ceiling and hold. Return to neutral and repeat.

name: Resisted Lateral Cervical Flexion with Band
instructions: Band around head anchored to side. Tilt head away against resistance through full range. Control return.

name: Side-Lying Head Lift
instructions: Lie on side. Lift head off surface laterally keeping face forward. Hold and lower slowly.

name: Isometric Lateral Cervical Flexion
instructions: Seated, place palm against temple. Press head into hand without moving. Hold isometric contraction.

name: Wall Push-Up
instructions: Hands on wall at chest height. Bend elbows to lower chest toward wall then push back to start.

name: Progressive Single Finger Abduction
instructions: Place hand on table. Abduct each finger individually away from midline. Hold then return.

name: Band Finger Abduction
instructions: Wrap rubber band around finger pairs. Spread against resistance through full range. Control return.

name: Finger Spreading Unresisted
instructions: Place hand flat on table. Spread all fingers as wide as possible. Hold then bring together.

name: Sequential Finger Adduction
instructions: Spread all fingers wide. Bring each adjacent pair together in sequence, one at a time. Control fully.

name: Lateral Pinch Resistance
instructions: Place each finger pair together. Apply manual resistance with opposite hand trying to spread them. Hold.

name: Paper Pinch Between Fingers
instructions: Place thin paper between adjacent fingers. Squeeze fingers together to grip paper as it is pulled.

name: Sequential Finger Extension
instructions: Curl into fist. Extend fingers one at a time from pinky to index. Then close one at a time in reverse.

name: Tabletop Finger Extension
instructions: Place hand flat on table. Lift each finger up from table as high as possible. Hold each lift briefly.

name: Rubber Band Finger Extension
instructions: Loop rubber band around all fingertips. Spread fingers apart against band resistance. Control return.

name: Fingertip Table Press
instructions: Place fingertips on table. Press down firmly through fingertips resisting with opposite hand. Hold.

name: Hook Fist
instructions: Curl fingers at first two joints keeping knuckles straight. This isolates FDS. Hold and release.

name: Ball Squeeze
instructions: Hold soft ball or rolled towel. Squeeze all fingers firmly and hold. Release fully. Repeat.

name: Short Foot Exercise
instructions: Standing barefoot. Pull ball of foot toward heel without curling toes to dome arch. Hold contraction.

name: Toe Spread and Squeeze
instructions: Seated barefoot. Spread toes wide and hold, then squeeze together. Control each movement fully.

name: Towel Toe Curls
instructions: Seated barefoot, towel on floor. Scrunch towel toward you using toes only. Repeat.

name: Single-Leg Squat with Lateral Band
instructions: Band above knees. Single-leg squat keeping knee in alignment and resisting band collapse inward.

name: Standing Hip Abduction with Band
instructions: Band above ankles, stand on one leg. Lift opposite leg out to side against resistance. Control return.

name: Side-Lying Hip Adduction
instructions: Lie on side, top leg bent in front for balance. Lift bottom leg up toward ceiling. Hold and lower.

name: Supine Adductor Squeeze
instructions: Lie on back, knees bent. Place pillow between knees. Squeeze pillow firmly and hold.

name: Resisted Hip Flexion March
instructions: Band looped around both ankles. March in place driving knees up against resistance. Stay tall.

name: Standing Hip Flexion with Band
instructions: Band around ankle anchored behind you. Standing, lift knee forward and up against resistance. Lower slowly.

name: Seated Hip Flexion March
instructions: Seated tall at edge of chair. Alternate lifting knees toward chest against gravity. Keep trunk upright.

name: Wall Sit
instructions: Back against wall, lower until knees are 90 degrees. Hold position with quads engaged.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
instructions: Kneel with feet anchored under couch. Lower body forward slowly by allowing knees to extend. Push back up.

name: Standing Hamstring Curl with Band
instructions: Band around ankle anchored in front. Stand on one leg. Bend knee curling heel toward glute against resistance.

name: Prone Knee Bend
instructions: Lie face down. Slowly bend one knee bringing heel toward glute. Lower under control. Keep thigh on floor.

name: Bird Dog with Pause
instructions: Hands and knees. Extend opposite arm and leg, pause three seconds at top maintaining neutral spine.

name: Back Extension Hold
instructions: Lie face down, hands behind head. Lift chest off floor using lumbar extensors. Hold at top.

name: Prone Press-Up
instructions: Lie face down, hands under shoulders. Press up onto elbows lifting chest. Keep hips on floor.

name: Banded Woodchop
instructions: Band anchored high. Pull diagonally down and across body rotating trunk. Control return slowly.

name: Supine Trunk Rotation Hold
instructions: Lie on back, knees bent. Let knees drop to one side and hold using obliques to resist further movement.

name: Unilateral Dumbbell Shrug
instructions: Hold household weight in one hand. Shrug that shoulder toward ear through full range. Lower slowly.

name: Bilateral Shoulder Shrug
instructions: Standing. Shrug both shoulders toward ears fully. Hold and lower slowly with control.

name: Serratus Punch with Band
instructions: Band anchored behind, arm forward at 90 degrees. Punch further forward protracting scapula. Control return.

name: Wall Push-Up Plus
instructions: Hands on wall, slight bend in elbows. Push chest away from wall rounding upper back (serratus activation).

name: Scapular Retraction Isometric
instructions: Seated tall. Squeeze shoulder blades together firmly. Keep shoulders away from ears. Hold.

name: Shoulder Abduction Isometric
instructions: Stand arm's length from wall. Press back of wrist against wall lifting arm to 30 degrees. Hold.

name: Band Crossover Adduction
instructions: Band anchored high to side. Pull arm diagonally across body and slightly downward. Control the return.

name: Band Shoulder Adduction
instructions: Band anchored above at side. Pull arm down and across body keeping elbow straight. Control return.

name: Isometric Shoulder Adduction
instructions: Stand with arm at side. Press upper arm against body firmly as if trying to crush something beneath arm. Hold.

name: External Rotation at 90 Degrees Abduction
instructions: Arm out to side at 90 degrees. Rotate forearm up toward ceiling against band resistance.

name: Band External Rotation
instructions: Elbow at 90 degrees at side, band in hand. Rotate forearm outward against resistance. Control return.

name: Isometric External Rotation
instructions: Elbow at 90 degrees at side. Press back of wrist against door frame. Hold isometric contraction.

name: Band Shoulder Extension
instructions: Band anchored in front at shoulder height. Pull arm back past hip keeping elbow straight. Control.

name: Shoulder Overhead Press
instructions: Standing with light weight. Press arm from shoulder height to full overhead. Lower with control.

name: Band Shoulder Forward Raise
instructions: Stand on band. Raise arm forward to 90 degrees with thumb up. Lower slowly.

name: Shoulder Assisted Pendulum
instructions: Lean forward resting uninvolved arm on surface. Let involved arm swing forward and back in small arc.

name: Internal Rotation at 90 Degrees Abduction
instructions: Arm out to side at 90 degrees. Rotate forearm down toward floor against band resistance.

name: Band Internal Rotation
instructions: Elbow at 90 degrees at side, band in hand anchored to side. Rotate forearm inward. Control return.

name: Isometric Internal Rotation
instructions: Elbow at 90 degrees at side. Press palm against door frame rotating inward. Hold isometric contraction.

name: Bird Dog
instructions: Hands and knees. Extend opposite arm and leg simultaneously, bracing spine. Hold then alternate.

name: Superman Hold
instructions: Lie face down, arms overhead. Simultaneously lift arms, chest, and legs. Hold at top then lower.

name: Prone Thoracic Press-Up
instructions: Lie face down, arms at sides. Lift chest slightly off floor using thoracic extensors only. Hold briefly.

name: Eccentric Wrist Extension
instructions: Use other hand to extend wrist. Remove assisting hand and lower slowly using extensors eccentrically.

name: Wrist Extension with Dumbbell
instructions: Forearm on table, hand off edge palm down. Lift wrist up with light weight. Full range, slow return.

name: Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: Seated, forearm on thigh, hand over knee palm down. Lift wrist toward ceiling. Lower slowly.

name: Eccentric Wrist Flexion
instructions: Use other hand to curl wrist up. Remove assisting hand and lower slowly using flexors eccentrically.

name: Wrist Flexion with Dumbbell
instructions: Forearm on table, hand off edge palm up. Curl wrist up with light weight. Full range, slow return.

name: Wrist Curl
instructions: Seated, forearm on thigh, hand over knee palm up. Curl wrist up toward ceiling. Lower slowly.

name: Pronation Against Band
instructions: Band around palm anchored in supinated position. Rotate forearm to palm down against resistance.

name: Pronation with Hammer
instructions: Hold hammer at mid-shaft, elbow at 90 degrees. Rotate forearm palm down against weight of hammer head.

name: Forearm Pronation Unresisted
instructions: Elbow at 90 degrees. Slowly rotate forearm palm down through full range. Return to neutral.

name: Radial Deviation with Band
instructions: Band around thumb side of hand anchored below. Deviate wrist toward thumb against resistance.

name: Radial Deviation with Hammer
instructions: Hold hammer vertically at base, thumb up. Move wrist into radial deviation (thumb side up). Control.

name: Gravity-Assisted Radial Deviation
instructions: Forearm on table thumb up, hand off edge. Allow wrist to drop (ulnar dev), then lift (radial dev).

name: Supination Against Band
instructions: Band around palm anchored in pronated position. Rotate forearm to palm up against resistance.

name: Supination with Hammer
instructions: Hold hammer at mid-shaft, elbow at 90 degrees. Rotate forearm palm up against weight of hammer head.

name: Forearm Supination Unresisted
instructions: Elbow at 90 degrees. Slowly rotate forearm palm up through full range. Return to neutral.

name: Ulnar Deviation with Band
instructions: Band around outside of hand anchored below. Deviate wrist toward small finger against resistance.

name: Ulnar Deviation with Hammer
instructions: Hold hammer vertically at base, thumb up. Move wrist into ulnar deviation (small finger down). Control.

name: Gravity-Assisted Ulnar Deviation
instructions: Forearm on table thumb up, hand off edge. Allow wrist to drop (radial dev), then lift (ulnar dev).

name: Prone Ankle Plantarflexion Stretch
instructions: Lie face down, feet off bed edge. Allow gravity to pull foot into full plantarflexion range.

name: Kneeling Dorsiflexor Stretch
instructions: Kneel sitting on heels with tops of feet flat. Gently shift weight backward pressing top of foot down.

name: Seated Ankle Plantarflexion Stretch
instructions: Seated, loop towel under toes. Gently pull toes downward into plantarflexion. Hold.

name: Weight-Bearing Peroneal Stretch
instructions: Stand on slight inward tilt (edge of mat). Allow foot to invert gently loading peroneal stretch.

name: Standing Peroneal Stretch
instructions: Stand with foot turned inward (inversion). Hold onto surface for balance. Feel stretch on outer ankle.

name: Seated Ankle Inversion Stretch
instructions: Seated, cross foot over opposite thigh. Gently turn sole inward stretching peroneal muscles.

name: Weight-Bearing Eversion Stretch
instructions: Stand on slight outward tilt (edge of mat). Allow foot to evert gently loading invertor stretch.

name: Standing Tibialis Posterior Stretch
instructions: Stand with foot turned outward (eversion). Hold surface for balance. Feel stretch along inner ankle.

name: Seated Ankle Eversion Stretch
instructions: Seated, cross foot over thigh. Turn sole outward gently stretching tibialis posterior muscle.

name: Seated Gastroc Stretch
instructions: Leg straight, loop towel around foot. Pull toes toward shin until stretch felt in calf.

name: Progressive Cervical Flexion Stretch
instructions: Seated, drop chin to chest. Apply both hands to back of head and gently increase flexion range.

name: Suboccipital Release Stretch
instructions: Lie on back with rolled towel at base of skull. Gently nod chin down to lengthen suboccipitals.

name: Supported Cervical Extension Stretch
instructions: Lie on back over rolled towel at upper thoracic. Allow head to gently fall back into extension. Hold.

name: Prone Cervical Press-Up Stretch
instructions: Lie face down, hands under shoulders. Press up onto elbows allowing neck to gently extend back.

name: Cervical Rotation Overpressure Stretch
instructions: Rotate head to one side. Place hand on chin and apply gentle overpressure into further rotation.

name: Cervical Rotation with Lateral Flexion
instructions: Rotate head to one side. Add slight lateral flexion toward same side to deepen cervical rotation stretch.

name: Scalene Stretch
instructions: Tilt head to side. Rotate chin slightly upward toward ceiling to bias scalene muscles. Hold stretch.

name: Wall Tricep Stretch
instructions: Place bent elbow on wall above head. Gently let body weight increase elbow flexion and tricep stretch.

name: Overhead Tricep Stretch
instructions: Raise arm, bend elbow to reach down back. Use other hand to gently push elbow into further flexion.

name: Wall Bicep Stretch
instructions: Place palm flat on wall behind at waist height. Step away rotating body until deep bicep stretch.

name: Progressive Finger Adduction Stretch
instructions: Apply progressive pressure adducting fingers together. Work from radial to ulnar side sequentially.

name: Lateral Finger Overpressure
instructions: Hold one finger and use other hand to press adjacent fingers toward it. Hold gentle adduction stretch.

name: Adjacent Finger Squeeze Stretch
instructions: Place fingers together side by side. Squeeze gently and hold to stretch lateral finger structures.

name: Maximum Finger Spread Stretch
instructions: Spread fingers maximally. Apply gentle traction at each web space and hold at maximum spread.

name: Progressive Finger Abduction Stretch
instructions: Place fingers on table spread wide. Gently press fingers apart applying overpressure at web spaces.

name: Finger Web Space Stretch
instructions: Use opposite hand to spread adjacent fingers apart. Work each web space individually.

name: Full Fist Overpressure Stretch
instructions: Close to full fist. Use opposite hand to gently push fingers further into flexion. Hold.

name: Hook Fist Stretch
instructions: Make hook fist curling PIP and DIP only. Apply gentle overpressure with opposite hand. Hold.

name: Passive Finger Flexion Stretch
instructions: Use opposite hand to gently curl all fingers into flexion. Hold stretch through all joints.

name: Intrinsic Plus Stretch
instructions: Hold MCP joints flat and flex PIP and DIP joints fully. Separates intrinsic from extrinsic stretch.

name: Table Extension Stretch
instructions: Place palm flat on table. Gently press fingers flat extending joints. Apply body weight gradually.

name: Passive Finger Extension Stretch
instructions: Use opposite hand to gently extend all fingers backward. Hold mild stretch through all joints.

name: Intrinsic Foot Stretch
instructions: Seated, cross ankle over knee. Use hands to spread toe web spaces and stretch all intrinsic muscles.

name: Plantar Fascia Wall Stretch
instructions: Stand with toes against wall at 45 degrees. Hold to load plantar fascia and intrinsic foot muscles.

name: Passive Toe Extension Stretch
instructions: Seated, manually pull toes back into extension. Hold to stretch plantar fascia and toe flexors.

name: Seated Figure-4 Piriformis Stretch
instructions: Seated, cross ankle over thigh. Lean trunk forward keeping back straight until gluteal stretch.

name: Cross-Leg Glute Stretch
instructions: Seated in chair, cross ankle over opposite thigh. Gently press knee downward. Lean forward slightly.

name: Lateral Lunge Adductor Stretch
instructions: Step wide to one side, lower into lunge keeping other leg straight. Feel stretch in straight-leg inner thigh.

name: Wide-Leg Seated Stretch
instructions: Seated on floor, legs spread wide. Hinge forward at hips reaching hands between legs.

name: Supine Butterfly Stretch
instructions: Lie on back, soles of feet together. Let knees fall out to sides. Gently press knees toward floor.

name: Standing Forward Fold
instructions: Standing, hinge at hips letting hands reach toward floor. Keep back relatively straight.

name: Supine Figure-4 Stretch
instructions: Lie on back. Cross ankle over opposite thigh forming figure-4. Pull thigh toward chest.

name: Pigeon Pose Hip Flexor Variant
instructions: From plank, front shin forward toward opposite wrist. Lower hips to floor. Square hips forward.

name: Standing Hip Flexor Stretch
instructions: Stand staggered. Shift weight forward stretching back hip flexor. Keep trunk tall.

name: Seated IT Band Stretch
instructions: Seated on floor, cross bent knee over straight leg. Rotate trunk toward bent knee applying overpressure.

name: Cross-Leg IT Band Stretch
instructions: Lie on back, cross one leg over other. Let both knees fall to opposite side until outer hip stretches.

name: Standing IT Band Stretch
instructions: Cross one leg behind other. Lean sideways away from back leg. Feel stretch along outer thigh.

name: Prone Quad Stretch
instructions: Lie face down. Bend knee and reach ankle with hand. Pull toward glute. Hold with hip neutral.

name: Side-Lying Quad Stretch
instructions: Lie on side. Pull top ankle toward glute with hand. Keep hips stacked. Hold position.

name: Standing Quad Stretch
instructions: Stand on one foot. Pull opposite ankle toward glute. Keep knees together. Hold.

name: Progressive Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Supine, leg up. Apply gentle overpressure to heel to increase knee extension range.

name: Seated Forward Fold
instructions: Seated on floor, legs straight. Hinge forward at hips reaching toward feet. Hold with relaxed back.

name: Prayer Stretch
instructions: Kneel, sit hips back toward heels. Reach arms forward on floor stretching entire lumbar spine.

name: Knee to Chest Stretch
instructions: Lie on back. Pull one or both knees to chest and hold to stretch lumbar extensors.

name: Upward-Facing Dog Stretch
instructions: Lie face down, hands by chest. Press into full arm extension arching back. Thighs off floor.

name: Standing Lumbar Extension Stretch
instructions: Standing, hands on lower back. Gently lean backward into lumbar extension. Hold and return.

name: Prone Cobra Stretch
instructions: Lie face down, elbows under shoulders. Press up onto elbows arching low back. Keep hips on floor.

name: Progressive Trunk Rotation Stretch
instructions: Seated rotation with hand behind head. Rotate and overpressure with elbow for increased range.

name: Seated Trunk Rotation Stretch
instructions: Seated on floor, one leg straight. Cross other foot over, place elbow on bent knee. Rotate toward it.

name: Supine Lumbar Rotation Stretch
instructions: Lie on back, knees bent. Drop both knees to one side keeping shoulders flat. Hold.

name: Combined Neck and Shoulder Depression Stretch
instructions: Tilt ear toward shoulder. Actively depress opposite shoulder toward floor increasing stretch.

name: Prone Pec Stretch
instructions: Lie face down, arm out to side at 90 degrees. Gently roll onto that side stretching chest.

name: Chest Opener Stretch
instructions: Clasp hands behind head. Pull elbows back squeezing shoulder blades. Open chest toward ceiling.

name: Thoracic Flexion Stretch
instructions: Seated, clasp hands behind head. Curl forward letting elbows drop toward thighs. Hold.

name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
instructions: Bring arm across chest. Hold above elbow with opposite hand and pull gently across body.

name: Seated Forward Reach Rhomboid Stretch
instructions: Seated, clasp hands and reach arms forward rounding upper back. Let shoulder blades spread apart.

name: Posterior Capsule Stretch
instructions: Lie on side of involved shoulder. Stabilize with body weight. Gently press forearm toward floor.

name: Cross-Body Stretch with Overpressure
instructions: Arm across chest. Apply downward pressure at elbow increasing horizontal adduction range.

name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
instructions: Bring arm across chest. Use opposite hand to hold above elbow. Hold stretch in posterior shoulder.

name: Child's Pose Lateral Reach
instructions: Kneel and sit hips back. Walk hands far to one side reaching to stretch shoulder adductors.

name: Doorway Lat Stretch
instructions: Hold door frame at shoulder height. Step back allowing shoulder to reach into flexion and abduction.

name: Standing Side Stretch
instructions: Raise one arm overhead and lean sideways. Feel stretch along side of trunk and shoulder.

name: Progressive Sleeper Stretch
instructions: Sleeper stretch position. Gently increase overpressure with each breath. Move into new range.

name: Horizontal Internal Rotation Stretch
instructions: Arm behind back. Gently reach opposite hand and pull wrist upward toward spine.

name: Doorway Overhead Shoulder Stretch
instructions: Hold door frame overhead. Let body weight gently sink creating traction and stretch on posterior shoulder.

name: Overhead Tricep and Shoulder Stretch
instructions: Raise arm and bend elbow overhead. Use other hand to pull elbow back. Feel stretch at shoulder.

name: Shoulder Wall Walk Stretch
instructions: Stand facing wall. Walk fingers up wall reaching high. Hold at end range to stretch extensors.

name: Extended Arm Wall Stretch
instructions: Arm behind at shoulder height against wall, palm forward. Rotate body away amplifying anterior stretch.

name: Doorway Anterior Shoulder Stretch
instructions: Stand in doorway, arm along frame. Step through rotating body away from arm until stretch.

name: Standing Shoulder Extension Stretch
instructions: Clasp hands behind back. Gently lift arms and roll shoulders back to stretch anterior shoulder.

name: Corner Pec Stretch
instructions: Stand in corner, arms on each wall at 90 degrees. Lean into corner until deep anterior chest stretch.

name: Doorway Pec Minor Stretch
instructions: Forearms on door frame, elbows at 90. Step through while keeping shoulders back and down.

name: Door Frame External Rotation Stretch
instructions: Elbow at 90 degrees, press palm against door frame. Rotate body gently away until anterior stretch.

name: Foam Roller Thoracic Extension
instructions: Foam roller perpendicular under mid-back. Support head. Extend over roller shifting to each level.

name: Thoracic Extension over Chair
instructions: Sit in chair, arms crossed. Extend spine over chair back targeting mid-thoracic region.

name: Progressive Wrist Flexion Stretch
instructions: Full wrist flexion stretch with overpressure and finger curl added. Hold deepest position.

name: Tabletop Wrist Flexion Stretch
instructions: Place back of hand on table, fingers pointing away. Gently press down to increase wrist flexion.

name: Wrist Flexor Stretch
instructions: Extend arm forward palm up. Use other hand to bend wrist back (extension) until forearm stretch.

name: Reverse Prayer Stretch
instructions: Press backs of hands together, fingers pointing down. Lift hands toward chest. Hold.

name: Prayer Position Stretch
instructions: Press palms together at chest. Lower hands toward waist keeping palms pressed. Wrist flexors stretch.

name: Wrist Extensor Stretch
instructions: Extend arm, use other hand to gently flex wrist with fingers pointing down. Stretch on forearm top.

name: Progressive Supination Stretch with Wrist
instructions: Combine full supination with wrist extension. Apply overpressure at both positions simultaneously.

name: Supported Supination Stretch
instructions: Elbow supported on table. Apply gentle overpressure guiding forearm into maximum supination.

name: Passive Forearm Supination Stretch
instructions: Elbow at 90 degrees. Use opposite hand to gently guide forearm into full supination. Hold.

name: Combined Wrist and Finger Ulnar Stretch
instructions: Ulnar deviation with fingers extended. Apply gentle overpressure at end range.

name: Progressive Ulnar Deviation Stretch
instructions: Forearm supported. Use opposite hand to guide wrist into maximum ulnar deviation. Hold.

name: Wrist Ulnar Deviation Stretch
instructions: Hold wrist and gently push hand toward small finger side (ulnar deviation) to stretch radial deviators.

name: Progressive Pronation Stretch with Wrist
instructions: Combine full pronation with wrist flexion. Apply overpressure at both positions simultaneously.

name: Supported Pronation Stretch
instructions: Elbow supported on table. Apply gentle overpressure guiding forearm into maximum pronation.

name: Passive Forearm Pronation Stretch
instructions: Elbow at 90 degrees. Use opposite hand to gently guide forearm into full pronation. Hold.

name: Combined Wrist and Finger Radial Stretch
instructions: Radial deviation with fingers extended and splayed. Apply gentle overpressure at end range.

name: Progressive Radial Deviation Stretch
instructions: Forearm supported. Use opposite hand to guide wrist into maximum radial deviation. Hold.

name: Wrist Radial Deviation Stretch
instructions: Hold wrist and gently push hand toward thumb side (radial deviation) to stretch ulnar deviators.
